quarterly_data.signal: Cerebras' IPO prospectus, full-year 2025: total revenue was $509,991 thousand versus $290,252 thousand in 2024 (+76%); hardware revenue $358,440 thousand (+69%) and cloud and other services revenue $151,551 thousand (+94%), so hardware was 70.3% and cloud and other services 29.7% of revenue. Gross profit was $199,071 thousand, 39.0% of revenue versus 42.3% in 2024. The prospectus adds that its top ten customers by year-to-date revenue through December 31, 2025 increased their aggregate spend with Cerebras by approximately 80% within 12 months of their initial purchase, often including contracts for co-development.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2025 revenue $509,991 thousand (+76%); hardware $358,440 thousand (+69%); cloud and other services $151,551 thousand (+94%); gross profit 39.0% of revenue; top ten customers' spend up approximately 80% within 12 months

quarterly_data.signal: Product claims in Cerebras' IPO prospectus (company comparison with NVIDIA's B200 'Blackwell'): the WSE-3 carries 4 Trillion Transistors versus 208 Billion Transistors for the B200 package, and puts high-performance SRAM directly on the wafer for 21,000 Terabytes/s of memory bandwidth - which Cerebras says is 2,625 Times More Memory Bandwidth than NVIDIA's B200 Package, resulting in Up to 15 Times Faster Inference Speeds (Cerebras internal measurements on April 14, 2026).
quarterly_data.figure: 4 Trillion Transistors (B200: 208 Billion); 21,000 Terabytes/s memory bandwidth; up to 15 times faster inference (company claim)

contracts.signal: Cerebras' IPO prospectus: OpenAI selected Cerebras to be its fast inference solution; Cerebras powers OpenAI's Codex Spark model, OpenAI's first model designed for real-time coding. The partnership also allows hardware and software co-design - OpenAI can design future models for Cerebras's architecture and Cerebras can design future hardware based on OpenAI's input. The multi-year agreement covers 750MW of Cerebras compute, to be deployed in tranches; the MRA with OpenAI, entered in December 2025, 'represents a substantial portion of our projected revenues over the next several years'.
contracts.type: model serving deployment (Codex Spark) and hardware/software co-design
